# Raj Classroom

> A bilingual educational platform offering interactive quizzes, video lessons, and teaching activities for primary and entrance exam preparation across English, Telugu, and EVS subjects.

Raj Classroom serves teachers and students in Andhra Pradesh with SCERT-aligned resources for Classes 1-6, specializing in entrance exam preparation for AP Model Schools and Residential Schools. The platform combines interactive learning tools, grammar exercises, language activities, and practice tests in both English and Telugu.

## Key Topics

- AP Model School Entrance
- Interactive Quizzes
- Telugu Language Learning
- English Grammar
- Video Lessons
- EVS (Environmental Studies)
- Primary Education
- Language Teaching
- Picture Reading
- Bilingual Learning
- Entrance Exam Preparation
- SCERT Syllabus
- ESL/EFL Teaching
- Grammar Exercises
- Spelling Games

## AP Model School & Residential School Entrance

- [AP Model School 6th Entrance: Every Drop is Precious Bilingual Quiz (EVS)](https://www.rajclassroom.com/2026/02/ap-model-school-6th-entrance-water-evs-quiz.html): Bilingual 45-question EVS quiz on water conservation for AP Model School 6th entrance preparation.
- [AP Model School Class 6 Entrance Exam Grand Test 2026 | 5th Class EVS SCERT Practice](https://www.rajclassroom.com/2026/02/ap-model-school-6th-entrance-evs-grand-test.html): Free bilingual EVS grand test for AP Model School 6th entrance based on SCERT syllabus.
- [AP Model School 6th Class Entrance Math Grand Test 2026: Bilingual Practice Sets](https://www.rajclassroom.com/2026/03/ap-model-school-6th-class-entrance-math-grand-test-2026.html): Free bilingual 100-mark math grand test for AP Model School 6th entrance with SCERT syllabus.
- [Kondavaagu (కొండవాగు)- Model School Entrance Practice Quiz | 5th Class Telugu | AP Model School Entrance Bits](https://www.rajclassroom.com/2026/02/kondavaagu.html): 50-question Telugu practice quiz on Kondavaagu lesson for AP Model School 6th entrance exam.
- [AP Residential Class 5th Entrance - Subtraction Quiz (4th Maths)](https://www.rajclassroom.com/2026/02/ap-residential-class-5th-entrance.html): Online subtraction practice quiz for AP Residential 5th entrance covering regrouping and profit-loss.

## English Grammar & Vocabulary

- [Punctuation Marks Quiz (End Punctuation) | 30 English Grammar Questions](https://www.rajclassroom.com/2026/02/punctuation-marks-english-grammar-quiz.html): Interactive 30-question punctuation quiz for Class 5-6 covering question marks, exclamation marks, and full stops.
- [Master Antonyms: 30 Question Vocabulary Quiz (5th Grade English)](https://www.rajclassroom.com/2026/02/english-antonyms-vocabulary-quiz.html): Interactive 30-question antonyms vocabulary quiz for 5th grade and entrance exam preparation.
- [Common vs Proper Nouns - Learner Centered Touch and Learn Grammar Material](https://www.rajclassroom.com/2018/09/common-vs-proper-nouns-learner-centered.html): Interactive kinesthetic grammar material on common and proper nouns for primary English teaching.
- [Cat Whiskers Activity - A Bilingual Grammar Activity to Teach WH Question Words](https://www.rajclassroom.com/2025/09/cat-whiskers-activity-bilingual-grammar.html): Bilingual grammar activity for teaching WH question words in Telugu and English for primary learners.
- [Welcome to School - A Ted Ed based interactive video lesson.](https://www.rajclassroom.com/2020/08/vocabulary.html): TED-Ed based interactive video lesson for school vocabulary and grammar articles for primary students.

## Interactive Learning Games & Activities

- [Interactive English Ladder Race: A Fun 2-Player Spelling Game for Kids (Grades 1-2)](https://www.rajclassroom.com/2025/12/english-ladder-race-spelling-game .html): Two-player spelling game for Grades 1-2 students to practice 3-4 letter words interactively.
- [Telugu Alphabet Practice: Learning Letters 'థ', 'ఖ', 'చ', 'త', and 'ధ' - Interactive Game](https://www.rajclassroom.com/2026/03/telugu-alphabet-practice-tha-kha-chha-tha-dha-game.html): Interactive FLN game for Telugu alphabet practice with mahaprana consonants and phonics activities.
- [Animate Any Drawing with AI- Complete Guide for Teachers & Creators](https://www.rajclassroom.com/2025/11/animate-any-drawing-with-ai-complete.html): Complete guide for using Meta's Animated Drawings tool to create AI animations in classroom settings.
- [TARIGONDA VENGAMAMBA (తరిగొండ వెంగమాంబ)- Creative Writing Activity](https://www.rajclassroom.com/2024/03/tarigonda-vengamamba-creative-writing.html): Creative writing activity on Tarigonda Vengamamba for 5th class Telugu literature and devotional poetry.

## Telugu Language Learning

- [Telugu Picture Reading Video Lesson SANAGA (శనగ)](https://www.rajclassroom.com/2017/05/telugu-picture-reading-video-lesson_23.html): Telugu picture reading video lesson on Sanaga letters for 1st grade language learning.
- [Telugu Picture Reading Video Lesson PALAKA (పలక)](https://www.rajclassroom.com/2017/03/telugu-lesson-palaka.html): Telugu picture reading video lesson on Palaka for first-grade alphabet and reading practice.

## Teaching Methods & Language Skills Development

- [3 Practical Ideas to develop Speaking Skills.](https://www.rajclassroom.com/2018/09/3-best-practical-ideas-to-develop.html): Three practical teaching techniques and TLM models for developing speaking and reading skills.
- [An Outstanding Reading Activity to Primary School Children.(1st and 2nd Class)](https://www.rajclassroom.com/2016/09/outstanding-reading-activity-to-primary.html): Creative reading activity for 1st-2nd class with vocabulary instruction for ESL learners.
- [Lesson Plan and Transaction Process of the Video Lesson "Rainy Day"](https://www.rajclassroom.com/2017/11/transaction-of-video-lesson-rainy-day.html): Lesson plan and transaction process for 'Rainy Day' video lesson from Class II English textbook.

## Literature & Poetry Resources

- [Transaction of the "Nation's Strength" poem](https://www.rajclassroom.com/2016/10/a-nation-strength-rhyme.html): Teaching resource for 'A Nation's Strength' poem with patriotic values and choreography activities.
